title: Going to New York: Ben Webster's advice and his aunt
summary: With Cal Cobbs he took a bus to New York with drums and vibes, staying with his aunt, arriving at 22.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: No, we decided to come to New York, because Ben Webster had told me, he says --
Well, you haven't told me -- oh, yeah. That's right. Because passing through Ben told you that.
Yeah, right. And he said, 'If you ever come to New York come to see me and don't worry about anything. I'll take care of you.'
So it so happened that I had an aunt who was moving to New York.

Yeah. So I passed through Pittsburgh, and she said, 'Well, I'm going to New York, so I think the best thing for you two,' like Frank and I, 'is to come to New York if you're going to make it in music.' So I said okay. So she left about a month before we did. So Carl and I, we took a bus
out of Cincinnati and went to New York, with all these drums and the vibraphones wrapped in blankets.
We came through the Holland Tunnel, and Call says, "Well, Kenny, here's New York." I said, "My God," and I started shaking. I was so afraid I didn't know what to do.
Yes, about. Let's see, '36, yeah, I was 22.
Uh-huh. So as luck would have it --
So that's the very same year we when you came in the room started talking about, (Unintelligible).
